_comment: POI rules. Edit this file, then run: python3 scripts/generate_poi_config.py. It rewrites the generated parts of the tag-mapping XMLs, the VTM theme and (add-only) tags-to-keep.json. zoom = zoom level from which the POI is stored and drawn. size = icon size in percent (optional, default 100). hide_if = POI is not drawn when one of these tags has one of these values. variants = other icon when a secondary tag has a given value; the default icon is used when the tag is absent or has another value.
